title: CuRe: Cultural Gaps in the Long Tail of Text-to-Image Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on a cultural representativeness benchmark (CuRe) spanning six broad axes (food, art, fashion, architecture, celebrations, and people). While it mentions religion as a future extension and includes 'Religious Building' as a subcategory, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the work.
